name: Market Street
description: Your protected base. Familiar shopkeepers keep a route open even after a bad day.

name: Foundry Row
description: A compact commercial row with modest returns and stubborn local loyalties.

name: Lantern Walk
description: Old favors travel along this sheltered street. Its corner opens a route to the clubs.

name: Dry Dock
description: The port's western gateway; holding it supplies the waterfront blocks.

name: Tide Market
description: Independent traders value predictability. Their earnings suffer when supplies are cut.

name: Container Yard
description: A valuable stretch of harbor businesses, expensive to protect and easy to isolate.

name: Velvet Row
description: A discreet club quarter and the first connection into the city's night economy.

name: Neon Square
description: Visible status earns well here. Every public setback travels twice as quickly.

name: Backstage Mile
description: A service corridor linking Portside, the Strip and the industrial belt.

name: Furnace Gate
description: The foundry entrance connects the western docks to a demanding industrial market.

name: Rail Spur
description: A central supply junction. Its useful position makes it a frequent rival target.

name: Assembly Block
description: A broad work district with high returns, costly maintenance and little patience for weak leadership.

name: Regency Plaza
description: The first foothold among private towers; every agreement carries a premium.

name: Glass Court
description: A quiet private market whose neighboring rail connection determines its reliability.

name: Meridian Rise
description: The skyline's most prestigious block. Occupation brings rewards and relentless obligations.
